packageRules.description: templ's runtime, which go.mod requires, and its generator, which tools/go.mod runs, move in one PR: the generated code is written for the runtime of the same version, so a bump of either alone leaves the two apart.

pnpm installs a release only once it is 7 days old (minimumReleaseAge in pnpm-workspace.yaml), and refuses a younger one, so Renovate proposes none sooner: a PR for a younger release would fail its lockfile update.

pnpm as mise.toml installs it and as package.json's packageManager names it move in one PR, after the same 7 days, so the pnpm that installs locally and in CI is the one Renovate updates the lockfile with.

Playwright brings the builds of Chromium, Firefox and WebKit the browser suite runs, and a new build can move pixels in the approved screenshot baselines. Only just browser and the dispatched browser.yml check them, never a pull request's checks, so an update waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard: the baselines are then checked, and approved again if they change, with it.
